scope: Remove dedicated tie features; standardize spare board-hole patterns; provide normal screw-head/rail clearance; use one BEC8V→SVPDB5V cascade; review saved cart options without requiring unrelated/spare removals.
intentional_changes: Common20mmM2 future-module pattern on three carriers and optional power platform; FC/power also30.5mmM3. Preserve confirmed device holes and separate project structural tower feet.
Plain rectangular decks replace tie tabs/slots. Battery retains three documented continuous adhesive regions. Optical tray stays an uninterrupted functional adhesive exception.

Raise equipment support deck1.2mm with one integral central support bridge, giving1mm nominal clearance between modeled2mm M2 heads and rail. Derive equipment, wiring and optical/power elevation; propulsion and rail mating geometry unchanged.

Optional tether topology is24V→oneBEC12S-PRO8V→FC/main and SVPDBinput8V→servo5V; shared upstream5A includes conversion losses. Remove active dualBEC configuration and unsupported fixed tether-trajectory reserve.

Record saved cart selected variants, distinguish cart units from pack counts, preserve known deferredM3screws and ownedM2/GHstock. OptionalM1.4nuts are sellerbrass, with genericcopper-alloy density estimate; horn hardware summary is profile-aware.

native_tests.superseded_test_failure: One old absolute Z probe at16.2mm in test_wiring_reserves was updated to the actual FC-envelope bottom minus4mm, preserving the midpoint requirement in the8mm wiring clearance. The failed13-test attempt and corrected13-test rerun are retained separately; production geometry/source did not change. Other passing modules were not repeated.

blender.scope: Sampled rigid transforms match native poses; not dynamics, collision, wire-flexibility, thermal or load simulation.

physical_limits: Current FC input-voltage sources conflict for2S/8V; received revision compatibility, current/thermal margin and actual wiring remain unresolved.

Spare standard hole patterns do not qualify arbitrary future devices or simultaneous installation in occupied bays. Device mounting stacks, fastener length, printed fit/strength and strap retention still require physical checks.
No fixed or load-rated tether guide/anchor is designed. Strap route, cable length/gauge, voltage drop and propeller/FOV clearance require actual installation review.
Mass values are nominal BRep/density estimates, not measured printed or all-up mass.

fixture_promotion.basis: Independent old/new native BRep, placement, hierarchy, metadata and control audit completed before promotion. Retained transition record follows.

visual_review.finding: Rendered assemblies and print layout are legible. Carrier decks are simple flat shapes; optional display shows one BEC and one SVPDB, and both optical-host views remain visible. Screenshot inspection does not replace numeric clearance or physical fit checks.

modeled_print_mass.scope: Modeled baseline PA12 print volume times assumed density; not measured final mass. Optional power platform is excluded.
